mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_subscription ( account_id, alertname, enabled, created_by, created_at, created_ip, updated_by, updated_at, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{alertname}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedIp} ) ON CONFLICT (account_id, alertname) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_ip = EXCLUDED.updated_ip
